issue.title: [Enhancement]: aws_ecs_service: support deployment_configuration.early_success_criteria
issue.body:
### Description

Amazon ECS added early success criteria for rolling deployments. The `DeploymentConfiguration` API type now carries an `earlySuccessCriteria` member with `enable`, `healthyPercent` and `sourceServiceRevisionCleanup` (`BLOCKING` or `DEFERRED`). When enabled, ECS marks a rolling deployment successful once the configured percentage of new tasks is healthy, and with `DEFERRED` cleanup it drains the source service revision after the deployment completes instead of blocking on it. CloudFormation exposes this as `AWS::ECS::Service DeploymentEarlySuccessCriteria`.

`aws_ecs_service` has no way to set this today. The `deployment_configuration` block supports `strategy`, `bake_time_in_minutes` and `lifecycle_hook`, but not `early_success_criteria`, so the setting cannot be managed by Terraform and any value set outside Terraform is not represented in state.

Use case: services whose tasks use task scale-in protection and legitimately keep running for a long time after a deployment starts (queue workers draining multi-hour jobs). The AWS documentation for early success criteria recommends `DEFERRED` cleanup for exactly this case, so that CI/CD tooling with time limits is not blocked while the old revision drains.

### Affected Resource(s) or Data Source(s)

- resource/aws_ecs_service
- data-source/aws_ecs_service

### Potential Terraform Configuration

```hcl
resource "aws_ecs_service" "example" {
  # ...

  deployment_configuration {
    strategy = "ROLLING"

    early_success_criteria {
      enable                          = true
      healthy_percent                 = 100
      source_service_revision_cleanup = "DEFERRED"
    }
  }
}
```

### References

- https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/early-success-criteria.html
- https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/APIReference/API_DeploymentConfiguration.html
- https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/aws-properties-ecs-service-deploymentearlysuccesscriteria.html
- botocore `ecs/2014-11-13/service-2.json` shape `DeploymentEarlySuccessCriteria`

### Would you like to implement the enhancement?

No
